name: Woven: Wicflow, Direction B "The ribbon" (37.5 s, 1920x1080, 30 fps)
thesis: Wicflow weaves AI into the way a business already sells and works. The stage is one bright isometric model of the viewer's business, where a two-strand ribbon (blue for the AI at work, ink for your team) finds Anna's building firm, writes and sends the message after the team approves it, follows up, updates the CRM, threads the tools the team already uses, proves itself in one pilot, scales, and finally weaves itself into the Wicflow W.
allowed_patterns: An isometric model of the viewer's business (their company, their market, their tools), shown as an illustration. Nothing in it is named except the site's own demo.

A two-strand ribbon taken from the W mark: the blue strand #1769C2 is the AI at work and the ink strand #17171B is your team. Where the strands cross, the overlap is knocked out to white diamonds, as in the mark.
Two tags, 'Your team' and 'Your business', which are words from the VO.

The site's 'AI at work' card used as the status chip, labelled 'Example workflow' whenever demo data is visible. Its rows are verbatim: Found a company that fits, Wrote the first message, Your team approved it / Sent after a quick check, Anna replied, plus the site's times 09:02, 09:03, 09:14 and 11:40.

The site's demo content, verbatim: Building firm · 40 staff · Tampere; "Hi Anna, I saw you're hiring two salespeople…"; "Sounds useful. Thursday at 10?"; Meeting booked · Thursday 10:00; Meetings booked this week 7 → 8 (illustrative, as on the site).

The site's workflow strip 'Reach out → Follow up → Update your CRM'. From the illustrative sales view: 'Interested prospect' and 'Check in'. A 'Repeated tasks' tag, from the site's 'Repeated sales and office tasks'.

The 15 tool logos the site shows, in the site's order, on white tiles: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Gmail, Outlook, Google Sheets, Teams, Slack, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, n8n.

The pilot wording: 'Try one focused pilot', 'Measure what changes', 'Keep it going · Expand when it makes sense'. Flags reading 'Starting point' and 'Goal', taken from the FAQ ('a starting point and a measurable goal'), shown without numbers.
The site's three service tints as the world's districts (sage, blue, sand), the OG card's pale circle #E3E9F4, and the site's black pill button used both as the company's door and as the CTA.
The only symbolic objects: a sales funnel (from the site's 'sales funnel'), a stack of task slips for manual work, and floors added to the company block for growth. No chart and no figures.
One full field of accent blue #1769C2 (P20), and one zoom-through (B16) through the mark's own white diamond (P20 to P21).
Small B5 overshoot pops of 8% or less, on check badges, flags, tags, tool tiles and reply bubbles only.
The W mark (the exact traced path), 'wicflow.com', the hero line 'An AI partner that runs your sales and marketing.' and the 'AI analysis' black pill on the end card.
world:
One bright isometric model of the viewer's business, built in code.

PROJECTION AND CAMERA
- True isometric at 30°, U = 58 px per world unit.
- Screen position = origin + ((x-y)·0.866·U, (x+y)·0.5·U - z·U).
- The world group breathes: ±1.2% scale and a 6 px float on a 7 s sine (B15), plus a yaw drift from 43° to 47° over 0 to 30 s.
- No camera pans or zooms, ever.

BACKGROUND AND BOARD
- The ground of the film is paper #FFFFFF.
- The OG card's pale circle (#E3E9F4, 1100 px across, centred at (1760,60)) drifts left at 12 px/s for the whole film (B10).
- The board appears in P3. It is a white slab of 12×8 units, 0.3 thick:
  - top #FFFFFF, left face #F4F4F7, right face #EDEDF1
  - edges #D6D6D9 at 1.5 px
  - soft shadow rgba(10,10,13,.07), 60 px blur, 28 px down
- Board corners: top (1100,300), right (1703,648), bottom (1301,880), left (698,532). The board sits right of centre, so the chip slot (top-left) and the captions (bottom-left) stay clear.

THREE PLATES (the site's service tints)
- Plates are 14 px slabs. Top = tint[2]. Sides = the same tint mixed with ink at 6% (left) and 11% (right).
- LEFT, sand #EAE1D1, 'your team / everyday work', centre ≈ (925,535). It holds:
  - YOUR COMPANY: a white block 2×2×1.4 units (about 200 px wide). Top #FFFFFF, left #F4F4F7, right #E9E9EE, with a black pill door #0A0A0D (the site's button) on its left face.
  - A stack of 6 task slips: sand #F0E9DC, each with two #D6D6D9 text lines.
- TOP-RIGHT, blue #DFE7F3, 'the market', centre ≈ (1300,530). It holds 10 small white blocks (1×1 units, heights 0.6, 0.9 and 1.2). One of them is Anna's building firm, at the back right, ≈ (1420,450).
- BOTTOM-RIGHT, sage #DDE8DE, 'sales and your tools', centre ≈ (1300,750). It holds the funnel, and later the CRM card and the 15 tool tiles.

BLOCKS
- Default: top #FFFFFF, left #F4F4F7, right #E8E8EC, hairline #D6D6D9.
- Found block: top #F1F5FB with a 2 px #1769C2 top edge.
- Customer block: top #DFE7F3 with a 2 px #1769C2 top edge.

UPRIGHT READABLE ITEMS
- Text never lies on an iso plane. Everything readable stands upright, facing camera: cards, tags, chip, tool tiles, bubbles.
- Style: white #FFFFFF; radius 24 (cards), 18 (tiles), 20 (chip), 999 (tags and pills); hairline #0000001F; shadow 0 24px 60px rgba(10,10,13,.10).
- Text is Manrope: ink #17171B, or muted #606069.

TYPE
- Captions: Space Grotesk SemiBold 64 px, −0.045em, at x 120. Last baseline at y 972; a second line sits 70 px above.
- Chip: at (110,86), 640 px wide.

COLOUR ROLES
- Blue #1769C2 only ever marks what the AI does: the blue strand, the live dot with its halo #1769C21F, found and customer edges, check marks, key words.
- Ink #17171B is your team (the ink strand) and the type.
- The tints mark the districts.
thread_object:
The two-strand ribbon is Wicflow's W, unwoven.

FORM
- A blue strand (#1769C2, the AI at work), headed by the site's live dot: 26 px, with a 10 px halo #1769C21F.
- An ink strand (#17171B, your team).
- Each strand is 16 px wide and lies flat in the iso ground plane with round caps. Together they run as a two-lane ribbon with a 6 px gap.
- Wherever they cross, the overlap is knocked out to paper white. Build this as an SVG mask: each strand is masked by the other's stroke. The result is the mark's diamonds, so the world is stitched with the logo's own checker.
- Draw-on uses stroke-dashoffset along the iso-projected path.

WHAT IT BECOMES, PHRASE BY PHRASE
- P1: the dot arrives.
- P2: the dot assists the ink strand.
- P3: it overtakes and leaves the first diamond, and the board unrolls in its wake.
- P4: it frays into construction threads that become the plates' edges.
- P5: its dot becomes the chip's dot.
- P9: the blue strand alone searches the market and finds Anna.
- P10: it curls up into the message card. The ink strand co-signs it, and the card folds back into a bead that the two-lane ribbon carries to Anna.
- P11: it ties the follow-up loop around her block.
- P12: it carries the reply down to the CRM.
- P13: it closes the system loop through all three plates.
- P14: it threads the 15 tool tiles.
- P15: it draws the pilot's scope line.
- P16: the ink strand straightens into the measuring line.
- P17: the route copies into many routes.
- P18: it carries the manual task slips away.
- P20: it thickens to every new customer.
- P21: the white diamond at its joint is the zoom-through, and then the ribbon turns upright.
- P22: it climbs the growing company as a helix.
- P23: it weaves the W. The blue strand traces ribbon A, the U from the top-left lobe (with its little tail) down to the bottom-centre and up to the top-right lobe. The ink strand traces ribbon B, the inverted V from the bottom-left up to the top-centre and down to the centre-right. Both widen to the mark's ribbon width, and their two crossings knock out the mark's white diamonds. The blue then darkens to ink #0A0A0D, and the exact traced wicflow-mark.svg replaces the strands on a held frame.

PAYOFF
The logo was two strands, the AI and your team, woven together all along.
colour_plan:
The ground of the film is paper white #FFFFFF. Every colour change is a mask that grows out of a named object and later shrinks back into it.

  - sage #DDE8DE for sales
  - blue #DFE7F3 for marketing
  - sand #EAE1D1 for everyday work, flooding out from under the company's black pill door
- P9 at 10.80: a pale blue field #F1F5FB (the site's customer-acquisition tint) grows from the market plate across the background (circle mask, 18 f). It recedes into the plate at 17.90.
- P13 at 18.43: a pale sage field #F1F6F1 (connected tools) grows from the white diamond at the loop's joint. It shrinks back into the joint from 21.20 to 21.50.
- P15 to P17: white. During the pilot, the world ghosts to 28% opacity and desaturates around the one route.
- P18 at 26.23: a pale sand field #F8F4EC grows out of the task stack. It recedes into the last slip at 27.55.
- P20 at 29.45: the one full field of accent blue #1769C2 grows out of the farthest customer block, behind the white board, for about 1 s. Captions switch to white as the mask passes under them.
- P21 at 30.40 to 30.70: the white diamond at the joint zooms through and returns the film to white. White holds through the end card, with the OG circle top-right.

Text colours: ink #17171B for type; muted #606069 for secondary text and for words not yet spoken; key words in #1769C2.
motion_identity:
PERSONALITY
"Pulled by the ribbon": quick off the mark with silky landings; energetic but clean. The liveliness comes from the ribbon's speed and from content, never from the camera.

SIGNATURE CURVES
- ARRIVE, expo-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1): every arrival and every rise out of the board.
- The ribbon head uses a speed-matched pull (the A1 shape): speed builds over 8 to 10 f into the fastest frame, then expo-out over 9 to 12 f. The next move starts at that speed.
- DEPART, cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.84,0): exits, at 70% of the entrance duration. Exits accelerate.
- MOVE, cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1): re-layouts.

DURATION PALETTE (frames at 30 fps)
- micro 6: word brightening, marker sweeps, A2 halves
- quick 9 to 10: pops, tags, A1 halves
- standard 12 to 14: plates, blocks, cards, masks
- slow 18 to 24: block slide, ribbon turn, the W weave, lockup slide
- ribbon travel 8 to 30 f, peak 1600 px/s or less, with 6 to 10 px directional blur on frames above 1000 px/s

ENTRANCE PATTERN
Everything enters out of something:
- out of the board, rising through a mask at the surface, and sinking back on exit
- out of the ribbon: cards curl up from it, beads ride it, the chip unfolds from its dot
- out of a word: marks

No fade-up in place, no blur-in, no scale-from-zero. Holds are working holds: a bead travels, the OG circle drifts, the breath continues.

CAPTIONS
- Words arrive at 35% muted and rise 14 px into ink over 6 f, 2 f before each word is spoken. The key word turns #1769C2.
- The outgoing caption leaves upward by 10 px in 7 f (DEPART) before the next one builds. Two lines never overlap.
- Hero marks: a two-strand ribbon underline (5 px blue over 5 px ink, crossing once with a white diamond, drawn left to right in 8 f) on 'forward', 'prospects', 'connects', 'pilot' and 'growth'.
- Other marks:
  - P2: a blue strike through 'assist'.
  - P6 to P8: tint marker sweeps.
  - P18 to P20: one slot with an A2 drop-through.

OVERSHOOT
Only B5 small pops (8% or less): check badges, 'Starting point' and 'Goal' flags, the 'Your team' and 'Check in' tags, tool tiles (5%), reply bubbles. Never on blocks, plates, cards, captions, the W or the end card.

CAMERA
- One breath for the whole film (B15: ±1.2% scale, 6 px float, 7 s period) plus a 43° to 47° yaw drift.
- No pans and no zooms.
- The single zoom-through is the diamond element scaling.

VOCABULARY USED
A1, A2, A6, B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B7, B9, B10, B11, B12, B13, B15, B16.
transition_family: The ribbon becomes the next thing: dot → strand → construction threads → chip dot → search path → message card (curls up) → bead → follow-up loop → connector through the tools → scope line → measuring line → many routes → helix → the W.

Out of the board and back into it: plates, blocks, the funnel, slips, the CRM card, tool tiles and floors rise through a mask at the board surface and sink back into it on exit (exits accelerate). The board itself unrolls tile row by tile row (P3, and again for the scale-out in P17).

Tint fields grow from the ribbon's touch points. Plate floods use iso-ellipse masks. Background fields use circle masks grown out of a named object, each later receding into the object it came from: pale blue from the market (P9), pale sage from the loop's joint (P13), pale sand from the task stack (P18), accent blue from the farthest customer (P20).

Speed-matched handovers: the ribbon head carries the eye between stations on A1 whips (speed builds into the fastest frame, then decelerates). Chip status rows, the CRM status pill and the result triplet's caption change by A2 drop-through in one slot.

One B16 zoom-through, the element scaling and never the camera: the mark's own white diamond, at the loop's joint by the company door, grows to fill the frame and opens onto the clean finale (P20 to P21).

end_card:
35.00 to 37.50 is the calmest moment of the film: the logo and the words arrive, and nothing else moves across the screen.

Background: white #FFFFFF, with the OG circle #E3E9F4 top-right, as on the site's OG card.

THE LOCKUP
- The W (the exact traced path, ink #0A0A0D) formed at 34.03 at 360 px wide, centred at (960,450).
- 35.00 to 35.80: it eases left and down to 200 px wide (B3, soft start and long settle, 24 f).
- 35.05 to 35.72: 'wicflow.com' (Space Grotesk SemiBold 112 px, −0.045em, ink #17171B) wipes out from behind the W's right edge (mask, left to right, 20 f).
- The lockup is centred at y 470: mark at about x 470 to 670, wordmark at about x 710 to 1450.

THE LINE
From 35.70, 'An AI partner that runs your sales and marketing.' (Manrope 500 36 px, muted #606069) builds word by word, 0.07 s a word, centred at y 600.

THE BUTTON
At 36.20, the site's black pill 'AI analysis' (#0A0A0D, text #EEEEF1 in Manrope 700 28 px, 64 px tall, radius 999) rises 16 px with opacity (ARRIVE, 14 f), at y 690. No click and no pulse.

HOLD
36.70 to 37.50: only the OG circle's 6 px drift and the breath. No ribbon, no orbit, no particles.

The last frame is 37.50 (f1125).

Sound: one soft pluck or chime as the wordmark reveals (35.05). The chord rings out, fades from 36.8, and is silent at 37.5.
music:
An original bed, 37.5 s, at 116 BPM (beat 0.517 s, bar 2.069 s), in D major. Bright, optimistic and tech-clean, matching the VO's energetic commercial read.

BAR GRID
The grid is anchored so a downbeat lands on 'Everything' (18.09). That puts downbeats at 1.54, 3.61, 5.68 ('Wicflow builds'), 7.74, 9.81, 11.88, 13.95, 16.02, 18.09, 20.16, 22.22, 24.29, 26.36 ('Less'), 28.43, 30.50, 32.57 and 34.64.

INSTRUMENTS
Felt piano; a marimba-like pluck ostinato in 16ths; round sub bass; a tight, soft kick; a snappy clap; shaker and closed hats; glockenspiel accents; a warm wide pad. No vocal chops and no EDM drop.

SECTIONS
1. 0.00 to 5.68, 'the question': piano and a pluck arpeggio, low-passed and opening from 600 Hz to 5 kHz; an airy pad; a reverse swell from 4.9 to 5.68.
2. 5.68 to 11.88, 'building': the groove enters. Soft four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, sub bass, open ostinato. A one-beat fill from 10.3 to 10.8.
3. 11.88 to 18.09, 'the demo': 16th hats are added. A 3-note glockenspiel motif answers the chip flips (12.73, 13.55, 16.87). A one-bar riser from 16.02 to 18.09.
4. 18.09 to 21.07, 'lift' (everything connects): open hats, a wider pad, bass up an octave, the motif doubled. Then a short filter-down, tape-stop style, from 21.07 to 21.52.
5. 21.52 to 26.36, 'pilot' breakdown: drums out except a soft rim click on 2 and 4; low-passed plucks and sub. From 23.4 a riser and snare roll build, with the filter opening on 'scale' (24.72) and a whoosh into 26.36.
6. 26.36 to 30.26, 'chorus' (Less / more / more): full kit, claps, and big chords (D, A, Bm, G). Accented hits on 26.38, 27.68 and 29.13. A cymbal swell under the blue flood from 29.45, then a breath of silence from 30.26 to 30.40.
7. 30.40 to 34.64, 'resolve': a rising whoosh into an airy impact on the zoom-through cut (30.70). Half-time kick, piano chords, pad and bass. Three warm tom-thuds on the growing floors (32.57, 33.09, 33.43; the third is placed on the picture, not the grid). The final D major chord lands on 'lasts' (34.17) with a glockenspiel shimmer and sustains.
8. 34.64 to 37.50, tail: the chord rings, with one soft pluck note on the wordmark reveal (35.05). Fade from 36.8; silent at 37.5.

MIX
- The VO sits on top. The music is ducked about 9 dB under the voice with a sidechain from the VO.
- SFX sit 6 to 10 dB under the VO, and are cued only on the moves in the cue sheet, not on every movement.
- Export AAC at 48 kHz.
risks: XOR crossings (white diamonds): masking each strand with the other strand's stroke can alias or flicker on fast frames. Fallback: precompute the crossing quads (the intersection of two band segments) and draw them as paper-white polygons.

The W payoff depends on two stroked centrelines that reproduce the traced mark (a U ribbon and an inverted-V ribbon, about 19% of the mark's width, round caps).
